tab.emptyDescription: Once you're added to a household, its schedule will show up here.

build.notAvailableDescription: Building a usual week is managed by a parent on this household.
build.draftErrorBody: We couldn't fetch the week you started. Check your connection and try again, or start this week from scratch.
build.noCarerBody: Add a nanny to your household before building a weekly schedule.
build.carerPickerSubtitle: Choose which carer will receive this week.
build.daysSubtitle: Tap the days you'd like to schedule.
build.hoursSubtitle: Pick a time range for each day, then which children are covered.
build.outsideHoursNote: You can still send this — it's just a heads-up.
build.reviewSubtitle: {{carerName}} will be able to accept or decline this week.
build.sendSuccessBody: {{carerName}} will be notified to review it.

pending.notAvailableDescription: This page is for parents and helpers. Ask a parent on this household if you need something changed.
pending.emptyBody: Build a usual week and send it to your nanny.
pending.draftBody: Finish building this week before sending it.
pending.withdrawConfirmBody: Your nanny won't be able to accept it after you withdraw.
pending.acceptedMeansShifts: {{name}} accepted this week. Individual shifts may still show as Pending on the calendar until each is confirmed.
pending.patternBannerDraft: Your usual week isn't sent yet
pending.adjustSheetDayTimeNote: Changing days or times still means sending a new usual week — this only covers skipping a week or changing the end date.
pending.adjustSkipWeekBody: Pick the week you'd like off, e.g. a school holiday. Shifts in that range won't be scheduled.
pending.adjustEndDateBody: Set a new date this usual week ends, or remove the current end date.
pending.adjustEndDateError: End date must not be before the start of this usual week.
pending.adjustEndDateConfirmBody: If the new date has already passed, this ends the usual week right away and removes any shifts it hasn't already confirmed.

respond.subtitle: Review the proposed week below.
respond.outsideHoursWarning: Outside the hours you marked available
respond.outsideHoursNote: You can still accept — this is just a heads-up.
respond.declineConfirmBody: You can let them know why, if you'd like.
respond.declineMessagePlaceholder: e.g. I can do mornings but not full days
respond.acceptedToast: Accepted! Shifts have been added to your calendar.
respond.structuralNoteLabelled: Shorter than a full day because “{{label}}”.
respond.structuralNote: These hours repeat every week — the family set them deliberately.
